name: solana-receive
description: Workspace scripts for Codama client generation (program lives under program/)

scripts.codegen: codama run js -c codama.mjs && node scripts/codegen-postprocess.mjs
scripts.codegen:check: sh -c 'untracked="$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- clients/js/src/generated)"; test -z "$untracked" || { echo "$untracked"; exit 1; }' && npm run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- clients/js/src/generated && sh -c 'status="$(git status --porcelain -- clients/js/src/generated)"; test -z "$status" || { echo "$status"; exit 1; }'
